Hey all!

We're coming up on the 60-day mark for the Foxcrest site build-out and I want to get everyone looped in on where things stand before we report up to the exec team next week. Booked an hour Thursday 1-2pm, Room 4 + video link for the store ops folks. 18 of us on the invite so grab a seat early 😄

Here's the plan:

1. Construction timeline: Yasmin Cho (15 min)
Permits are all approved, fixture install is starting on schedule. Yasmin will walk through the Gantt.

2. Budget snapshot: Dmitri Sorensen (10 min)
We're tracking about 2% under. Dmitri will share the slide he's sending to finance anyway.

3. Staffing & hiring: Esme Dube (10 min)
Store manager hired, assistant roles posted. Esme will share the hiring pipeline numbers.

4. Merch + planogram: Soren Varga (10 min)
Final planogram is signed off, so this is mainly a look at the layout renders 👀

5. Marketing for grand opening: Uriel Wexler (10 min)
Draft calendar of local promos. Uriel's open to feedback but the timing is mostly locked.

6. Anything else / Qs: Erik Fitzgerald (5 min)

If you have questions on any of these, feel free to drop them in the channel ahead of time so the owners can be ready. Decks will go out after.

Thanks so much, this project has been a really fun one to be part of 🙌

Farid
Store Development, Bluepath Market"}]}
